metadata.title: G1-Warrant Deterministic Autonomous Remediation, Containment & Attestation Control Plane

components.title: g1-warrant-core
components.description: Zero-LLM deterministic remediation control plane enforcing 2-of-2 DSSE Standing Warrants, OPA Rego AC-5 separation of duties, shadow canary differential gates, eBPF containment lockouts, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 POA&M closure attestations.

control-implementations.description: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 security and supply-chain control implementation for G1-Warrant

implemented-requirements.description: Every autonomous rollout, Cilium containment bridge, and exception resolution is gated by cryptographic Standing Warrant verification (fail-closed on missing, expired, or out-of-scope warrants). External 3PAO auditor bearer tokens (g1aud_*) are strictly isolated to /api/v1/auditor/* and return HTTP 403 on all operational endpoints.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/warrant/engine.go + internal/server/api.go Scoped Auditor Bearer Isolation

implemented-requirements.description: Untrusted external prose (SARIF 2.1.0, CISA KEV feeds, Google OSV.dev advisories, CycloneDX VEX, git diffs) is routed exclusively through the zero-privilege warrant-extractor service deployed on an isolated zero-egress network segment, emitting only regex-validated typed records.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: cmd/warrant-extractor + k8s/network-policy.yaml (Zero-Egress Content vs. Artifact Separation)

implemented-requirements.description: Standing Warrants, Fleet Thaws, and Ceiling Exceptions require 2-of-2 cryptographic signatures over RFC 8785 JCS canonicalized DSSEv1 PAE bytes from two distinct human principals holding disjoint institutional roles: Slot 1 SERVICE_OWNER and Slot 2 AUTHORIZING_OFFICIAL. Production SDKs and CLIs ship zero demo signers.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/warrant_ac5.rego + internal/crypto/dsse.go (2-of-2 Dual-Key Separation of Duties)

implemented-requirements.description: All Standing Warrant issuances, short-lived Task Warrant delegations (TTL <= 300s), extractor sanitizations, progressive canary transitions, containment bridges, quarantined rollbacks, and POA&M closures generate structured, millisecond-timestamped cryptographic audit records with SHA-256 input/output lineage.

PostgreSQL BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers enforce append-only immutability across warrant_envelopes, agent_action_ledger, attestation_records, and ledger_checkpoints, while TransparencyAnchor ships DSSE-signed binary Merkle Root checkpoints to an external WORM file/webhook boundary so even PostgreSQL superuser trigger-disable rewrites are cryptographically detected.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: db/migrations/001..003 + internal/ledger/anchor.go External Merkle Transparency Anchor

implemented-requirements.description: Warrants, ceiling exceptions, Merkle checkpoints, and NIST OSCAL 1.1.2 closure attestations are sealed inside DSSEv1 envelopes signed via non-exportable KMS/HSM EnvelopeSigner, Ed25519, or W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators over RFC 8785 JCS payloads.

Streams event-driven Kubernetes Pod WATCH notifications (?watch=true&allowWatchBookmarks=true&resourceVersion=...) without polling overload, automatically re-arming Cilium containment bridges upon runtime digest drift even during Emergency Freeze.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/adapters/k8s_live.go Streaming WATCH + internal/verify/engine.go Drift Watcher

implemented-requirements.description: Grades enterprise services across three graduated autonomy tiers: TIER_1_FULL_AUTONOMOUS (>=80% coverage, OTel probes, CoW/shadow DB, verified rollback), TIER_2_GUARDED_CANARY (brownfield SLI-guarded canary when authorized by warrant), and TIER_3_CONTAIN_AND_CAB (non-disruptive L3/L4 egress quarantine + Four-Eyes CAB).
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/gate_eligibility.rego + 3-Tier Graduated Fleet Autonomy Grader

implemented-requirements.description: Contains in seconds and verifies rollouts safely across configurable statistical sample/dwell windows using order-insensitive multiset JSON diffing, float epsilon tolerance, eBPF syscall/file/egress guards, and an atomic 3-step Contain-Before-Unban Quarantined Rollback state machine for post-closure latent regressions.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/gate/engine.go + internal/verify/engine.go Atomic 3-Step Quarantined Rollback

implemented-requirements.description: Authenticates organizational Authorizing Officials and Service Owners via native W3C WebAuthn hardware authenticators (RPID SHA-256 binding, User Present & User Verified hardware flags, ECDSA P-256 / Ed25519 verification) and live execution-time revocation checks.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/crypto/webauthn.go Native W3C WebAuthn PIV/FIDO2 Verification

implemented-requirements.description: External scanner, extractor, and rollout workers operate solely as governed delegates under DSSE-signed ephemeral Task Warrants (max TTL 300s) bound to an active human-co-signed Standing Warrant and explicit target asset scope.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/agentcp/controlplane.go Minute-Scoped Ephemeral Task Warrants

implemented-requirements.description: Eliminates false-negative closure from broken PoCs by requiring positive-control exploit confirmation against the unpatched digest before accepting EXPLOIT_BLOCKED on the patched digest (ASSURANCE_TIER_2_DIFFERENTIAL_TWIN), while attesting standard Trivy/OSV/KEV advisories without weaponized PoCs under ASSURANCE_TIER_1_PASSIVE_DIGEST_SBOM.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: policies/verify_closure.rego Differential Twin Positive Control & Dual Assurance Tiers

implemented-requirements.description: Separates ZERO_PROSE_EGRESS_MESH_QUARANTINE (cutting external world egress to block reverse shells/JNDI callbacks while preserving mTLS mesh traffic without blind L7 route guessing) from SIGNED_RULEPACK_L7_SHIELD (enforcing Envoy/Cilium HTTP rules only when backed by an Ed25519 publisher-signed CWE/CVE rulepack).

Verifies publisher Ed25519 cryptographic provenance on every candidate patch artifact prior to canary execution and sweeps 100% of live Kubernetes pod containerStatuses imageID SHA-256 digests plus unloaded vulnerable symbols before retiring containment.

Maintains a machine-readable CycloneDX 1.5 Software Bill of Materials with 100% SPDX license attribution across all Go, npm, and Python dependencies, enforcing zero GPL/AGPL copyleft contamination and SHA-pinned GitHub Actions.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: scripts/audit_licenses.py + reports/sbom.cdx.json (CycloneDX 1.5 + SPDX License Governance)

implemented-requirements.description: Supports non-exportable external KMS/HSM signing keys for attestation envelopes and enforces permanent Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy + OPA Gatekeeper SHA-256 digest lockouts banning vulnerable container images across the cluster.
implemented-requirements.remarks: Mechanism: internal/crypto/signer.go RemoteKMSSigner + Kubernetes ValidatingAdmissionPolicy Lockouts
